tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The ground: the page of the app and the website and the app's top bar (white cards sit on it in light, lighter cards in dark). Never an inset.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The container: the docs page ground; cards, panels, tables, dialogs, drawers, menus, popovers, toasts, inputs and the selected tab everywhere.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: The inset, only inside a container: wells, code blocks, table header rows, an inline note or empty state, skeletons. On the ground an inset becomes a bordered container (`.surface-inset`).

tokens.name: state-hover
tokens.usage: Hover: an ink overlay (`overlay-hover`) over any fill, on rows, menu items, nav items and buttons.

tokens.name: state-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed and open: an ink overlay (`overlay-pressed`) on a trigger whose menu is open, a toggled button and a segmented track.

tokens.name: state-selected
tokens.usage: Selected: an ink overlay (`overlay-selected`) on the selected row, list item or current nav item (with its 2px accent bar); never shared with hover.

tokens.name: stage-sky
tokens.usage: One tint the website's editorial illustrations draw with. Never text, a button, a card or a page fill.

tokens.name: stage-mint
tokens.usage: One tint the website's editorial illustrations draw with. Never text, a button, a card or a page fill.

tokens.name: stage-lilac
tokens.usage: One tint the website's editorial illustrations draw with. Never text, a button, a card or a page fill.

tokens.name: stage-peach
tokens.usage: One tint the website's editorial illustrations draw with. Never text, a button, a card or a page fill.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Every soft edge on `surface`: the 1px border of every container (card, panel, table frame, dialog, drawer, menu, toast), the chrome rules, table rules, dividers, the edge of a chip, tag, citation, kbd, secondary button and selected tab, and the resting edge of every form control (inputs, selects, textareas, chip inputs, the Agent composer, the docs search trigger, the CSV file input, checkbox and radio boxes), with shadow-edge under a field. A divider inside a dialog or the search palette is line, never darker, and line is the 3px halo around a focused field.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: One soft step darker than line: a divider or edge drawn on `surface-sunken`, where line would vanish, a form control's hover edge and the dashed edge of reserved slots (Turnstile, the new-workspace tile).

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Marks that need 3:1 but are not borders: the chart crosshair, the Switch's off track, the ink TextLink underline, the StepList pending ring and a not-cited engine mark. Never the edge of a control (that is line), card or box.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, primary text and numbers on paper, surface, surface-sunken and every -soft tint (accent-soft, positive-soft, negative-soft, warning-soft, info-soft): callout bodies are ink. Also the primary button fill and the inverted tile.

tokens.name: ink-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on hover.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Leads and body copy on the website, descriptions, unselected tabs, nav links. On paper, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, eyebrows, placeholders, timestamps, footer legal text. The secondary ink under another name: every surface has one grey.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill: the primary button label, the inverted tile.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Flare, the only hue: the logo bars and "Cite", active rungs, your own brand's citation number and chart series, the selected nav marker in the app. A mark, never body text, a button fill or a background.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent as text: inline links inside long reading copy (docs, blog, legal). On paper, surface and accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind ink: the highlighter mark and your own brand's citation pill or table row.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring, 2px offset, in ink. Passes 3:1 on paper, surface and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Gains, healthy checks, "cited", success toasts. Teal, so it never relies on red versus green alone. Text on paper, surface and positive-soft; always beside an arrow, icon or word.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Background of positive badges and success callouts.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Losses, failed checks, errors, destructive actions. Text on paper, surface and negative-soft; always beside an arrow, icon or word.

tokens.name: negative-soft
tokens.usage: Background of negative badges and error callouts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention, partial data, stale results, trial ending. Text on paper, surface and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges and callouts.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information callouts and "note" admonitions in docs. Text on paper, surface and info-soft; never decorative.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info callouts.

tokens.name: data-other
tokens.usage: The "Other" series and slice, always textured (a dashed line) and labelled, so it never reads as a fourth brand.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The backdrop behind dialogs, drawers and the command palette. Nothing else.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and axis baselines. Decorative.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The app's page. The website aliases its own role here; the app binds its value.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Sunken material: an answer passage, code, a user's chat turn; a chart's gap band. The website aliases its own role here; the app binds its value.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Sheets: menus, popovers, tooltips, dialogs, drawers, toasts. The website aliases its own role here; the app binds its value.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows inside a card and on chrome edges. The website aliases its own role here; the app binds its value.

tokens.name: control-line
tokens.usage: Boundaries that are the control's only cue (3:1): text inputs, textareas, selects, comboboxes, checkboxes, radios, a switch's off track, and the dashed edge of a draft. The website aliases its own role here; the app binds its value.

tokens.name: control-edge
tokens.usage: The soft edge of a control its visible words name: secondary and danger buttons, link-buttons, operable tags, menu triggers, pagers, search and filter fields, clickable cards, with shadow-control under it. No 3:1 needed (WCAG 1.4.11). The website aliases its own role here; the app binds #d5d8df light and #2f3033 dark.

tokens.name: control-fill
tokens.usage: The fill of a labelled control: secondary and danger buttons, selects, search and filter fields, operable tags. The website aliases the surface; the app's dark binds the well.

tokens.name: thumb
tokens.usage: An off switch's thumb. The surface; the app's dark binds ink-2, so the thumb reads on its dark track.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Supporting text: the second and last ink step. The website aliases its own role here; the app binds its value.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: The rare accent-coloured word, such as "You". The website aliases its own role here; the app binds its value.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: The highlighter behind your brand in a quoted answer; text selection. The website aliases its own role here; the app binds its value.

tokens.name: positive-wash
tokens.usage: The positive notice and validation wash. The website aliases its own role here; the app binds its value.

tokens.name: negative-wash
tokens.usage: The negative notice and validation wash. The website aliases its own role here; the app binds its value.

tokens.name: warning-wash
tokens.usage: The warning notice and validation wash. The website aliases its own role here; the app binds its value.

tokens.name: info-wash
tokens.usage: The info notice and validation wash. The website aliases its own role here; the app binds its value.

tokens.name: data-you
tokens.usage: Your brand in every chart and comparison, always.

tokens.name: data-rival-1
tokens.usage: The first rival series (ink).

tokens.name: data-rival-2
tokens.usage: The second rival series; cool hues only for rivals. The website aliases its own role here; the app binds its value.

tokens.name: data-rival-3
tokens.usage: The third rival series. The website aliases its own role here; the app binds its value.

tokens.name: data-rival-4
tokens.usage: The fourth rival series; a fifth and later are data-other. The website aliases its own role here; the app binds its value.

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: The app's chrome: the sidebar and the masthead, a step off the ground. The website has no chrome, so it aliases the ground; the app binds its value.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Docs page titles, the website's CTA band heading and the app's sign-in, sign-up and other auth card titles (there in the sans face at 500; the display face elsewhere). 26/32 below 768px. The website's pricing plan price sets this size in the sans face at 500.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Article h2 and the heading of a section that is one feature split. On the website large feature tiles, stacked split titles and the PageHighlight title set this size in the sans face at 500.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: A metric's figure in the app.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The app's PageHeader title, the sans face at 500 like every app title, in a 40px title row with the actions centred on it.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Docs h2, reference titles and an article's Sources heading. Website card, step and form titles and article h3 are heading-lg in the sans face at 500. Never in the app, which sets no display face.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: Captions under product frames and the docs h3. On the website FAQ questions, pricing plan names and the author's name set this size in the sans face at 500. Footer column heads are not this (they use label).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The app's flow headings, the new-chat greeting and full-page notices, in the display face.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: CiteLadder runs the questions your buyers ask ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, and shows which pages each answer cites.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a website hero or section heading, in ink-secondary. 18/28 below 768px.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Each prompt runs every morning on every engine you track.
styles.usage: Article and blog body copy (prose).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Three of your five product pages were cited last week.
styles.usage: Website body copy, docs prose, feature card descriptions.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: The app's default text: tables, forms, cards, menus. Footer links.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, field labels, nav items, footer column heads.

styles.name: label-lg
styles.usage: Large (control-lg) buttons and the website navbar links.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: App card titles, settings section titles and table group headings. The sans face never goes above 500.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Dialog and drawer titles and the billing plan name: the app's larger heading, in the sans face like every app title. On the website, card, step, form and tool titles and article h3.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The number in a key figure, the plan price in the app, and the website PageHighlight's figures. The sans face at 500, 28/36; the ScoreRing and DonutChart centres use the same face at 32/38.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Chart axes and footnotes, helper text under fields.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: The app's slip titles, table group heads and field-group legends.

styles.name: prose
styles.usage: The app's reading text: Agent replies, documents, long explanations; 60 to 80 characters a line.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a heading or a stat. Never a sentence.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Deltas, dates, IDs a person reads, citation numbers, inline code.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks in docs, blog and product frames.

styles.name: screen-label
styles.usage: The website's product screens only: card eyebrows and key-figure labels, uppercase. The app never uses it.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: At most one hero figure on an app page.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The app's key figures.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: The website's key caps (Kbd). In the app `code` overrides it.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge dot gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; product frame padding; navbar inset from the viewport top.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding (md); list row padding; the app's card gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: App card padding; the app page's top padding and the header-to-controls gap; field stack gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page gutter below 768px; frame caption padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Website card padding; gap between cards in a website grid; caption padding inside a feature card; the app page's side padding from 1280px.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Heading-to-content gap in a website section.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page gutter 768–1279px.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between a section header and its grid.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page gutter from 1280px (so a 1440 viewport shows a 1320 container); hero top padding below the navbar.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Vertical gap between website sections below 1024px.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Vertical gap between website sections from 1024px.

tokens.name: radius-2xs
tokens.usage: Chart bars, legend swatches, rungs.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, favicons, checkboxes, the highlighter mark, meter and progress tracks. Only slightly rounded everywhere.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tabs inside a track, menu items, small icon buttons, tooltips, citation pills, the announcement pill.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, the tab track, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: App cards and panels, menus, dialogs, the inner well of a product frame.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Only avatars, status dots, switch tracks (and their thumb), count pills (footnote numbers, nav counts) and the radio circle. Never a pill-shaped button, chip, citation or bar.

tokens.name: radius-mark
tokens.usage: The app's marks, tags, kbd chips, menu items, checkboxes and rung marks: the app binds 4px on its own scope (the website keeps 2px). The app has four radii (mark 4, control 6, card 8, overlay 12) plus full for avatars and switch thumbs.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: The app's controls, fields and wells: 6px in the app and on the website's own surfaces.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: The app's cards (sections, slips, stat cards) and its small overlays: menus, popovers, tooltips, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-overlay
tokens.usage: The app's modal overlays and flow cards: dialogs, drawers, the command palette, the Flow card.

shadow.note: The app has three shadows, one per elevation: card, pop and sheet (bound on the app's own scope); fields keep the faint shadow-edge and labelled controls shadow-control. The website and docs draw their borderless edges with the ring inside shadow-xs and shadow-pop.

tokens.name: shadow-edge
tokens.usage: The faint smudge under a form control's soft line edge: inputs, textareas, search fields, select triggers, chip inputs, checkbox and radio boxes, the Agent composer. No ring of its own, so the 1px border stays the only edge; shadow-xs would double it.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: The app's shadow under a labelled control's control-edge: secondary and danger buttons, link-buttons, operable tags. None on the website and docs.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Website and docs chips and pills whose ring is their edge, and the Switch thumb. Not an app edge.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: The website and docs floating surfaces whose ring is their edge: the mega menu, popovers, the docs search dialog, a product image. The app binds its own pop for menus and popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The app's one shadow, under a sheet. Nothing at rest has a shadow.

control.note: Control heights. Every interactive row in one view uses the same height.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: The app's compact controls: dense tables, toolbar buttons, citation pills.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: The smallest interactive target anywhere (WCAG 2.5.8): toggle boxes and field end buttons sit in it.

tokens.name: target-hit
tokens.usage: The tap area around a small control (`hit-area`): target-min, and 44 in the app below 900px or under a coarse pointer; the drawn control keeps its size.

tokens.name: tag-height
tokens.usage: A tag and a status mark.

tokens.name: control-coarse
tokens.usage: A primary target under a coarse pointer: 44 in the app; the website keeps control-md.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: App buttons, inputs, selects, the tab track, sidebar rows; navbar and docs top-bar buttons. 32 on the website, 28 in the app (owner, 2026-11-19); website CTAs stay control-lg.

tokens.name: row-app
tokens.usage: App table rows, and the project switcher and PageHeader title row that align across the sidebar and the page.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Website hero and CTA buttons, auth forms.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: The floating website navbar and the docs top bar.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: The app sidebar and the docs sidebar, expanded.

layout.note: Content widths. Gutters are space-5 below 768px, space-10 to 1279px, space-16 from 1280px.

tokens.name: container-site
tokens.usage: Max content width of every website section, the navbar and the footer.

tokens.name: container-app
tokens.usage: Max width of an app page's content inside the shell.

tokens.name: container-prose
tokens.usage: Article, legal and docs body column.

tokens.name: container-narrow
tokens.usage: Centred section headers, auth cards, onboarding steps, empty states.

tokens.name: container-form
tokens.usage: The app's form column.
